description: Office of the Governor Uva Province - Appointed Secretaries to the Uva Province with effect from 27.12.2019
categorisation: This gazette exclusively contains government personnel appointments (e.g., "Mr. W. M. M. G. Abeysinghe Banda as the Secretary to the Ministry...") with named individuals and their basic titles/positions. It does NOT include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas, which would be required for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification. The content focuses solely on who is being appointed to which positions.
